topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: Walking into this, I thought I'd seen it all. Essays stolen, identities swapped, but a college app essay out there for all to see? That's a new one. Kid came to me, wide-eyed, thought his shot at a better life was stolen and pasted all over the web. They say truth is the best defense, but when it's served cold and raw on the internet, it can sure as hell cut deep. Dug a little, found some shady websites, comments that smelled of hackers and copycats. I'm on the trail now. Ain't just a story; it's a kid's future. Gotta tie off this loose end, no matter where it leads.
